sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Interesting! When I clicked (19,36) [green (18,35)], (25,42) [green (24,41)], (37,42) [green (36,41)], nothing happened (no ring, no border). And the image shows the board with no selection ring — the last click (37,42) had no effect.
Wait, but the first click (19,24) = green (18,23) worked: border at (18,11) ✓ (consistent with before).
But the clicks on (18,35), (24,41), (36,41) didn't produce a ring?! Why?
Looking at the image: the green blocks are at (18,17), (18,23), (18,35), (24,41), (36,41). All 5 are visible. But clicking the ones on the right side does nothing?
Hmm, wait — maybe the click coordinates were off. (19,36): the block (18,35) spans rows 18-21, cols 35-38. Row 19, col 36 is inside. (25,42): the block (24,41) spans rows 24-27, cols 41-44. Inside. (37,42): the block (36,41) spans rows 36-39, cols 41-44. Inside.
So why no ring? Maybe... the ring only appears when the click "hits" the center of the green? Or maybe the green blocks on the right side are in a different state (e.g., "locked" vs "selectable")?
Wait, looking at the image again: the green at (18,35) — in the image, the green in the 5th column of the top row looks slightly different (darker, with a border?) compared to the others. Actually, in the current image, all 5 greens look the same light green.
Hmm, let me check the diff more carefully. Maybe the ring appeared and disappeared within the same frame (animation). The action returns the final frame; if the ring is temporary (blinking), I might have missed it. But the border (w→g) should persist.
Actually wait — the issue might be this: when I clicked (19,36), the previous selection was (18,23) with border at (18,11). Clicking another green might have deselected (the border at (18,11) should revert g→w). My diff filter was only looking for w→g changes (border appearance). If the click deselected, the diff would show g→w changes (border disappearance) — which I wasn't printing!
Let me redo this: click (19,36) and print all changes (excluding row 0).

- (18,23)→(18,11) confirmed again. But clicks on (18,35), (24,41), (36,41) showed no w→g border — possibly they DESELECTED (g→w) or did nothing. Need full diff.
